messages:
joni: Heads-up: draft plan for a migration sideband to move tenants off pinned older models with low disruption. want quick feedback.
felipe: Nice. high-level: shadow -> canary -> opt-in wave -> full. how do we avoid unexpected cost spikes?
joni: propose sampling + caps. 100% shadow only for 5-canary tenants, otherwise 5-10% sampling for broad population. add per-tenant cost guardrails.
li: operationally we need a per-tenant throttle and a global budget soft-limit that pauses shadows. also need metrics to compare outputs side-by-side.
hazel: devex: we'll provide tenant golden prompt templates and an onboarding checklist. include categories: identity, instruction-following, hallucination-sensitive.
joni: acceptance gates (candidate list):
- automated correctness delta <= 0.5% on tenant golden set
- p95 latency change <= 35ms
- compute cost delta <= 12%
- no new safety classifier flags

felipe: we should also track top-N example failures nightly and flag prompts that flip from correct->incorrect. add an alert for >0.2% flip rate.
li: logging: every response must carry model_version and rollout_tag headers. store trace rows for 90 days; enterprise can opt for 1y.
joni: rollback: per-tenant routing override. API: POST /tenants/{id}/route_override {model: vX, reason}. rollback path: flip route, clear cache, confirm golden set quick-check.
hazel: UX: Console Migration page with: toggle, per-tenant sampling slider, canary cohort selection, health badges (pass/warn/fail). provide export of "staying-on-pinned" tenants for legal.
felipe: infra cost mitigation: for wide shadow use low-sample mode and only sample 1 in N requests after prefix detection. canary uses full shadow for fidelity.
joni: evaluation infra: nightly job that writes a summary: mismatch_rate, avg_confidence_delta, latency_delta, token_cost_diff, top20 failing prompts. surface in Console and send digest to #product.
li: alert thresholds: mismatch_rate > 0.5% on golden set -> pager to eng-oncall. 0.1%-0.5% -> ticket to product. also create a "migration-smoke" dashboard.
hazel: comms copy draft: "We'll offer a controlled migration sideband so customers can opt in to newer models. Non-opt-in customers stay pinned. We'll provide metrics, rollback, and legal export." add FAQ about contractual pins.
felipe: legal/commit exceptions: implement a pin-exception label in tenant metadata; that prevents any auto-migration and kept out of sampling by default.
joni: schedule: pilot next Tue for 3 internal tenants (7d), then expand to 5 external canaries (48-72h each), then 2-week opt-in window.
li: success criteria after rollout: 1) no regression incidents caused by migration > 1/week, 2) median p95 latency across migrated tenants within 10% of baseline, 3) adoption > 65% by 8 weeks.
felipe: add auto-pause: if tenant compute cost delta > configured threshold -> pause migration for that tenant and notify billing + product.
joni: deliverables owner list:
- golden prompt templates (hazel)
- console controls + export (hazel + product design)
- routing override API + per-tenant throttle (felipe)
- nightly diff job + dashboard (li)
- comms + FAQ (joni)

ops-bot: Deploy bot: pipeline created project/model-migration/1747009999-pipeline
joni: ok i'll turn this into a short RFC and link runbook. we can review Friday triage for go/no-go.
hazel: I'll prep the templates and quick UX mock.
felipe: I'll stub the API and sampling controls.
li: I'll stand up the migration dashboard and alerts.
joni: thanks — any missing bits?
felipe: maybe add an emergency rollback SLA: we should be able to flip a tenant back within 30 minutes for canary failures.
joni: added. thanks all.
